frontmatter.name: android-jni-security
frontmatter.description: Audits, detects, and remediates Android JNI and native C/C++ boundary security vulnerabilities. Use this skill when reviewing, auditing, hardening, or securing Android JNI boundaries, Kotlin external or Java native methods, and C/C++ shared libraries (System.loadLibrary) against buffer overflow, memory pinning, Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) file path races, hardcoded C++ cryptographic keys, cross-thread JNI reference and session callback lifecycles, or unhandled pending JVM exceptions and local refe

1. JNI parameter mapping and release requirements
2. Boundary input validation and buffer bounds logic
4. Cryptographic keys and native memory scrubbing
5. Cross-thread reference lifecycles and pending JVM exceptions
